title: Incident-response decision log
html:
Incident-response decision log

Select appropriate actions during a suspected security incident.

Required responses

fields.label: First response to the alert

options.value: Validate and triage while preserving relevant evidence
options.label: Validate and triage while preserving relevant evidence

options.value: Assume the alert is always false
options.label: Assume the alert is always false

fields.correct: Validate and triage while preserving relevant evidence
fields.explanation: Initial analysis establishes the incident’s nature and supports an appropriate response.

fields.label: Response to proposed log deletion

options.value: Preserve relevant evidence under the response plan
options.label: Preserve relevant evidence under the response plan

fields.correct: Preserve relevant evidence under the response plan
fields.explanation: Uncontrolled deletion can impede investigation and legal obligations.

fields.label: Objective of containment

options.value: Limit further harm while coordinating the response
options.label: Limit further harm while coordinating the response

options.value: Guarantee no prior data was affected
options.label: Guarantee no prior data was affected

fields.correct: Limit further harm while coordinating the response
fields.explanation: Containment limits ongoing impact without replacing investigation.

fields.label: Post-recovery action

options.value: Review causes and improve controls and procedures
options.label: Review causes and improve controls and procedures

fields.correct: Review causes and improve controls and procedures

exhibits.title: Observed event
exhibits.html: A monitoring alert shows unusual privileged access to confidential records. The team has not confirmed the scope. A technician proposes deleting logs and immediately rebuilding every affected system.

exhibits.title: Response objectives
exhibits.html: Protect the business, preserve useful evidence, determine scope, contain the event, remediate causes, and recover through the approved process.

explanation:
First response to the alert

Initial analysis establishes the incident’s nature and supports an appropriate response.

Response to proposed log deletion

Uncontrolled deletion can impede investigation and legal obligations.

Objective of containment

Containment limits ongoing impact without replacing investigation.

Post-recovery action

Lessons learned support sustained improvement.
